annotations.title: Roles that are not filling, and employers reposting

description: Hiring Signals for a recruiter or staffing firm, read from employers' own careers sites: how many live roles have been open at least 3x longer than that same employer usually takes to close a role (stuck), how many roles employers took down and put back up in the last 30 days (reposts), with named examples (stated pay, top of $60K or more), nationally or for one state and one industry. Free counts and examples; the full row-level list is the Hiring Signals API, returned ready to call with the same filters.

industry.description: healthcare_clinical, software, engineering_hardware, finance_accounting, sales, skilled_trade, operations, admin_support, customer_service, retail_food, education, marketing, legal, data_or_analytics, hr_recruiting, science_lab - or plain words ("nursing", "warehouse", "accounting")

min_pay.description: Only roles whose stated pay tops out at least this (annual, or hourly if under 300); roles with no stated pay are kept

state.description: Two-letter US state, a state name, or US (the default)
